proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P transport IPC registration: multi-segment export/import, per-segment FD query/transfer, proxy-side segment mapping, and teardown/cleanup ownership in src/transport/p2p.cc plus related proxy hooks. Memory is also required because registration-cache and lifetime semantics changed (segment-count propagation through free helpers, mapped-range unmap/free behavior, and pcclCommDeregister callback-drain before local deregistration) in src/include/alloc.h and src/register/register.cc.
